description: This header file declares utility functions related to vendor dynamic linked kernel modules (dlkm) for the Android Cuttlefish project. It includes functions for splitting ramdisk modules, writing filesystem configurations, repacking super partition images, building vbmeta and dlkm images, and moving files conditionally based on content differences. The file provides the interface for kernel module handling and image processing within the build or deployment process.

Result<void> RepackSuperWithPartition(const std::string& superimg_path, const std::string& image_path, const std::string& partition_name)
Result<void> BuildVbmetaImage(const std::string& vendor_dlkm_img, const std::string& vbmeta_path)
Result<void> BuildDlkmImage(const std::string& src_dir, const bool is_erofs, const std::string& partition_name, const std::string& output_image)
bool MoveIfChanged(const std::string& src, const std::string& dst)
